capabilities.scope: driver capability checks linked to O3 LLVMDemangle, not whole-project LTO/PGO comparisons

command: PRAGMA integrity_check; SELECT count(*)>0 FROM t6;
PRAGMA integrity_check; SELECT count(*)>0 FROM t6;

checks: clean git state before each run
all sources cached, no curl events
repeat uses all configure caches and LLVM driver cache
production O3 compile databases have no ThinLTO/PGO flags
lit official reference output passes without binary hash metrics
large storage and actual TMPDIR remain in requested external directory

limits: No full Clang bootstrap; only LLVMDemangle built from official LLVM source
ThinLTO/PGO capability probes instrument/link the driver, not the complete projects
Only two LLVM test-suite workloads validated; SPEC CPU 2026 excluded
Source-text Zstd corpus and memory SQLite workload are readiness inputs, not production-representative datasets
Three process samples per run; uncontrolled frequency, cache and shared load; no speedup claims
